All Addl. CPFC (Zone)

Sub: Proper Entry in the data fields “Subject Matter” and “Amount of impugned
orders” in respect of Supreme Court cases in the Legal Dash Board.

Sir/Madam

Following deficiencies have. been observed in respect of the data entered in Legal
Dashboard by various offices:-

S.N Data Field Deficiency |

1 Case Subject Matter Blank or Wrong entries* |

2 Amount (if Determined or levied | Mostly Blank or “zero” amount
by the Impugned Order) shown

* Trrelevant information such as details of parties, details of impugned HC
order, etc. are being filled up.

2 It is requested to enter proper subject matter. Some of the relevant “Case Subject
Matter” are as follows:-

i. 7A Dispute: Applicability of Act - Basic Wage u/s-2(b) of the Act/ Subterfuge/
Minimum Wage
ii. 7A Dispute: Applicability of Act - Number of employees/ Definition of Employee
u/s-2(f) of the Act
iii. | 7A Dispute: Applicability of Act - infancy benefit
iv. 7A Dispute: Applicability of Act - clubbability
y. 7A Dispute: Applicability of Act — Coverage dispute on Schedule of Industry
Head /Class of Establishments for Coverage
vi. 7A Dispute: Amount of dues in default
vii.  14B dispute: rate of damages/ mens real etc.

viii. Pension dispute u/p-11(3) of EPS’95
ix. Pension dispute u/p-10(2) of EPS’95
x. Recovery digpute: BIFR/SICA/Liquidation
xi. Recovery dispute: section 17B of the Act
xii. Recovery dispute: section 8/8B-8G of the Act
xiii. Prosecution under section 14 of the Act
xiv. _ Dispute related to Exemption or its Cancellation
xv. Consumer Dispute: PF settlement/ Pension amount/ etc
xvi. Service Matter
xvii. _ EPFO is Proforma party, and EPFO’s interest is limited to
xviii. Other than above (please specify)

3 Further, the amount of the impugned 7A/14B Order or of the Recovery Certificate
should be invariably mentioned in the column heading “Amount (if Determined or levied by
the Impugned Order)”. In case there is no amount involved in the case, the amount must be
mentioned as “Not Applicable”.

4 OICs and Nodal Officers under your jurisdiction may please be directed to ensure
that these columns are filled-up with due care in the Legal Dashboard.

5 Needles to say, entries in other data fields must also be made appropriately.
Disposed cases must also be updated immediately so that they reflect in “Disposed Cases”
Report rather than under “Pending Cases” Report.

6 It is requested that the quality of entry of the data entered in Legal Dashboard
by the offices*under your jurisdiction must be regularly checked at your level and
regular instructions must be issued to them to set right the deficiencies wherever noted.

Yours faithfully,

i=

(Rajesh Bansal)
